nodes.label: Batches List Screen (PMS Web UI)
nodes.rationale: Screenshot of the Poultry Monitoring System 'Batches' page: dark-green persistent sidebar on the left, breadcrumb-style page title bar at top with the signed-in user and role chip, and a single white content card holding a filter/search toolbar above a striped data table. Purpose is to give an operator a scannable roster of production batches with their key health signal (mortality %) visible without drilling in.

nodes.label: Batch Record DEMO-B1
nodes.rationale: A single active batch row: code DEMO-B1, farm GreenFarms Demo Yaounde, status Active, age 53 days, current population 932, mortality 1.8%. The row exposes exactly the columns needed to triage a flock (identity, ownership, lifecycle stage, headcount, loss rate) and defers everything else to a 'View' detail action.

nodes.label: Batch Status Filter and Code Search Toolbar
nodes.rationale: Toolbar pairs an 'All statuses' select with a free-text 'Code...' box and a Go button. Server-side filter+search rather than client-side table sorting, which keeps the page usable when batch counts grow beyond one screen.

nodes.label: Mortality Percentage Column
nodes.rationale: Mortality % is surfaced as a first-class list column (1.8 for DEMO-B1), making flock loss the primary at-a-glance health KPI in the batch roster.

nodes.label: List-Toolbar-Table CRUD Layout Pattern
nodes.rationale: Every domain list page in the PMS web app reuses one template: H1 page heading on the left, filter/search controls plus a dark-green primary 'Add X' button on the right, then a full-width table with a pale-green header band and a right-aligned row action. Consistency lowers training cost for farm staff and lets new entity types be added without new interaction design.
